incidentCommentary: Stale Solbakken is forced to make a change. Julian Ryerson is unable to continue due to injury, Marcus Pedersen (Norway) comes on.

value.incidentCommentary: GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Marcus Pedersen (Norway) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 1:0.

incidentCommentary: Substitution. Fredrik Aursnes (Norway) makes way for Patrick Berg.
Erling Haaland (Norway) receives a precise pass inside the box from Martin Odegaard and he beats the goalkeeper with a neat finish into the right side of the net. 2:0.

A superb goal from great team play! Ismaila Sarr (Senegal) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent shot into the top right corner. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
The substitution has been made. Ismail Jakobs (Senegal) has replaced El Hadji Malick Diouf.
Pape Bouna Thiaw decides to make a substitution. Pape Gueye will be replaced by Ibrahim Mbaye (Senegal).

Patrick Berg is in a good shooting position, but he sees his teammate and passes the ball to him. Erling Haaland (Norway) takes it nicely and beats the goalkeeper with a precise shot which bounces in off the bar to make the score 3:1.
Edouard Mendy (Senegal) is substituted due to injury. Pape Bouna Thiaw gives a chance to Mory Diaw.
Here is a change. Lamine Camara is going off and Pape Bouna Thiaw gives the last tactical orders to Pathe Ciss (Senegal).
The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andreas Schjelderup (Norway) comes onto the pitch for Antonio Nusa.
Pape Bouna Thiaw prepares a substitution. Kalidou Koulibaly is replaced by Pape Matar Sarr (Senegal).
Torbjorn Lysaker Heggem (Norway) is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Leo Ostigard.
Stale Solbakken has decided to substitute Alexander Sorloth and he is replaced by Oscar Bobb (Norway).

GOAL! Superb work from Nicolas Jackson, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Ismaila Sarr (Senegal), who beats Orjan Nyland with a brilliant shot into the right side of the net. 3:2.
